annotations.title: TIA — set CPU password policy (GATE G6)

description: Changes the CPU's password policy in the project. GATE G6: the values are the site's security decision — take them from a HUMAN, never choose them yourself. Only the fields you pass change; pass at least one. The length and complexity fields live in the legacy policy service: on a CPU that exposes only the modern service just `enabled` applies — the result then lists the dropped fields in `ignoredFields`. A CPU with neither service is refused (409). Offline change: it reaches the CPU only with a later compile + download. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/passwordpolicy. Class M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

enabled.description: G6 (human decision): enforce the password policy

minNumeric.description: G6 (human decision): minimum number of digits

minSpecial.description: G6 (human decision): minimum number of special characters

requiresMixedCase.description: G6 (human decision): require lower- and upper-case letters
